descriptive: user 2026-11-26 ~20:18 and ~21:05 in whip-lead's chat ("if its missing data, run it yourself for anything indivudally under $100 and/or 6 hours"; "yes, open all four"): Fig 3's random updates read through E314's error share, values per task beside the fine-tunes', no verdict on reuse, no claim at the bar

settings.random_gain_min_source: E314's random floor (local_faith.MIN_GAIN, 1 log-odds); here it only flags an ok draw whose fp32 gain fell under it
settings.size_rel_tol_source: the rebuild runs E302's own code (random_direction on the same fp32 file, times signed_c, fp64 norms); only summation order can differ (~1e-15); a wrong file, seed or scale is off by far more

random_reference: E302's draws (experiments/random_logodds_share/results/states/<state>.json .draws, E228's seeds 228001-228003), rebuilt as random_direction(dW, seed) * signed_c: Gaussian per matrix at the fine-tune's norm, scaled until the trained answer rose 1.00-1.10 log-odds in E302's bf16 reader; KL not matched; 27 of 144 draws reached the band (status ok), the rest capped at 100x

error_share.definition: E314's: (L_patch - T0) / (T1 - T0), L_patch = base model with each of the 8 block-output sites' SAE error set to the update's error, all at once; here over the draw's own fp32 gain
error_share.zero_update: nan (read in E314 and E317, not again here)
error_share.control: the first state's fine-tune read again reproduces E314's saved error share exactly (E317 measured 0 difference on all 48)
error_share.random_if_rival_a: at or above the fine-tunes' values on the tasks where ok draws exist
error_share.random_if_rival_b: apart from the fine-tunes' values by more than 0.1 on those tasks
error_share.blind_to: tasks with no ok draw (E302 found them only on cipher or random-target tasks, all built new): no random reference there; the random gain (~1) is about a twelfth of the fine-tunes' (~10-21), and a ratio need not read the same at both

recon_share.definition: E317's: each site's reconstruction set to the update's, the base error kept, same ratio
recon_share.random: no filed expectation; read beside, descriptive

gain.expected: within a few percent of E302's bf16 gain of 1.00-1.10 for ok draws (fp32 here against bf16 there); recorded, no stop

not_a_verdict: plotted per task beside the fine-tunes' error shares; writeup-lead decides placement
